skills.name: Cursed Blade (不吉な刃)
skills.description: Youtou Hime uses her katana to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Ghostly Blade (幽撃)
skills.description: Whenever Youtou Hime deals a critical hit, her Crit DMG is permanently increased by 5% (max of 100%). When her Crit DMG reaches 350%, she enters the Glorious Blade state indefinitely at the start of her next turn. ; Glorious Blade (妖華) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Attacks ignore 50% of target's DEF. Each time allies use up a total of 8 onibi, and if she's not inflicted with controlling effects or Banished and similar effects, she uses Dazzling Cleave on a random enemy free of onibi. The attack prioritizes the enemy she last actively targeted with Dazzling Cleave. The damage of the attack is also halved. This effect's onibi count resets after it has been triggered.

skills.name: Savage Combo (殺戮)
skills.line: Never mess with a girl with a katana!
skills.description:
Youtou Hime launches a 6-strike attack on an enemy, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK with each strike. If the target is KO'd before she finishes her 6 strikes, she changes her target to the enemy with the lowest HP.
When she's in the Glorious Blade state, she gains the additional skill Dazzling Cleave. ; Glorious Blade (妖華) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Attacks ignore 50% of target's DEF. Each time allies use up a total of 8 onibi, and if she's not inflicted with controlling effects or Banished and similar effects, she uses Dazzling Cleave on a random enemy free of onibi. The attack prioritizes the enemy she last actively targeted with Dazzling Cleave. The damage of the attack is also halved. This effect's onibi count resets after it has been triggered.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 58% and deals an extra 2-strikes when changing targets.
